description.subtitle: Manchester City Puma Soccer Ball Size 5 - Purple
description.intro: Enjoy every touch as if you were at the Etihad Stadium with this Puma Manchester City ball. Its vibrant color design and durable construction make it a perfect choice for training or playing in style. Ideal for club fans and players looking for an authentic experience in each match.
key_benefits: Exclusive City design: Official aesthetic inspired by the club's culture.
Improved Durability: Durable construction for frequent use.
Precise touch: Optimized surface for superior ball control.
Outstanding Visibility: Intense colors for easy location in game.
Football inspiration: Connect with the passion of European football.
